pieces.Text: You run with preternatural speed and endurance.

When running, you move seven times your normal speed if wearing medium, light, or no armor and carrying no more than a medium load, or six times your speed if wearing heavy armor or carrying a heavy load. When making a jump after a running start, you gain an additional +
bonus on your Acrobatics check. You can run normally for
rounds, but after that you must succeed at Constitution checks to continue running.
